title: JANUS Slime Activation Memory Profile
purpose: Define what Slime knowledge should settle in durable JANUS/meta-registry memory versus what must remain ephemeral or runtime-owned adaptive state.

persist: verified durable receipts/checkpoints that explain state changes
must_not_persist_as_truth: training-arena winner labels without holdout evidence

persist: stable route statistics with explicit epochs and decay semantics

activation_specific_profile.selection_policy: COMPOSE_AND_TEST rather than inherit a historical mega-core wholesale.

when_a_better_slime_is_found: state which mechanisms were retained, rejected or replaced
never rewrite historical evidence to make the descendant look inevitable

project_memory_statement: For JANUS activation work, Slime is remembered as a governed adaptive-routing family, not as a mystical label or a single historical source file. The durable memory is the lineage, constraints, evidence and validated receipts; the living routing signal is allowed to decay.
claim_ceiling: This record defines JANUS internal memory architecture and archival interpretation. It does not confer authority on unverified runtime state or historical source code.
